parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of incident filing types for the specified company. Each filing type represents a severity classification (e.g. first aid, lost time, fatality) that can be assigned to an injury record.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[active]
parameters.description: If true, returns item(s) with a status of 'active'.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction. Use the value to sort ascending, or prefix with a hyphen (e.g. -name) to sort descending.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the filing type.

name.description: Name of the filing type (e.g. report_only, first_aid, lost_time, fatality). Procore-provided filing type names cannot be changed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this filing type was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: Unique identifier of the severity level.

name.description: Display name of the severity level. May be customized by the company.

procore_default_name.description: Procore's original default name for this severity level, before any company customization.

active.description: Whether this severity level is active and available for assignment.

email_trigger.description: Whether recording an incident with this severity level triggers an email notification.

push_notification_trigger.description: Whether recording an incident with this severity level triggers a push notification.

order.description: Numeric ranking of this severity level, used for ordering from least to most severe.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this severity level was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this severity level was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.
Timestamp when this filing type was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/incidents/injury_filing_types?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bactive%5D=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
